answer: Trust that snaps under one removal was never trust. Certify cascade-immunity: each vouching graph is stress-tested by simulated removal of random voucher subsets; certification passes only if standing survives. A willow bends and holds; a clone grove is one root with a thousand trunks - cut the operator node and all falls at once, which the simulation finds in seconds. Organic networks spread weight across many knolls of support and shed a branch without losing the hill. Every certified graph gets a haven rating gating privileges: immunity unlocks standing; brittle graphs stay capped.
